run_lammps_with_fairchem: run a LAMMPS simulation using a FairChem MLIP predictor with a given input script path and task name
lookup_atomic_number_by_mass: lookup atomic numbers from atomic mass values with a 0.1 tolerance and raise ValueError on bad matches
atomic_data_from_lammps_data: create an AtomicData object from LAMMPS position arrays, atomic numbers, cell, and periodicity parameters
check_input_script: check a LAMMPS input script string for force field commands like pair_style that would conflict with MLIP forces
FixExternalCallback: create a FixExternalCallback callable that computes MLIP forces and energy from a LAMMPS simulation step
